data.narrative:
SandboxAQ is a Series E quantum computing company founded by Jack Hidary, currently valued at $5.8B post-money with $950M+ deployed capital. The valuation assessment benchmarks against a comp universe of 11 quantum computing peers: three public (IonQ, Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum) and eight private firms including Quantinuum ($14.8B, Series G) and PsiQuantum ($7.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement, yielding $8.0B. Peer-median methodology across six same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables produces $6.6B, with the broader peer set ranging from $1.9B to $14.8B. The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in technology approaches and commercialization progress within quantum.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $5.6B (low) to $9.3B (high), with a median of $7.3B. This brackets the current $5.8B valuation near the lower quartile of the derived range. Key uncertainties include the timing and probability of quantum advantage demonstrations in commercially relevant applications, competitive maturation of hardware and software platforms across the peer set, and capital requirements for the next funding stage. The wide peer range ($1.9B–$14.8B) underscores that sector-level comparability is limited; individual company valuations diverge materially on technical milestones and customer traction.
